items.title: Alec Pierce: Receives second PRP injection
items.body_text: Pierce (anke) received a second PRP injection in his left ankle this offseason, James Boyd of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Penix: Still working in 7-on-7 drills
items.body_text: Penix (knee) had some nice plays during 7-on-7 drills at Monday's practice, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rachaad White: Penciled in as No. 2 RB at camp
items.body_text: White was listed as the Commanders' No. 2 running back on the team's unofficial depth chart Monday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Set to operate as bellcow
items.body_text: Hall is expected to be featured more prominently as the Jets' lead back this season, Connor Hughes of SNY.TV reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: RJ Harvey: Focused on big plays in 2026
items.body_text: Harvey expects to provide a lot of big plays in Year 2 with the Broncos, Susanna Weir of the team's official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
